steps.label: django-probe
command: import django,json,tempfile; django.setup(); from django.core.management import call_command; from django.db import connection; import redis; call_command('migrate',interactive=False,verbosity=0); call_command('check'); cursor=connection.cursor(); cursor.execute('select version(),current_database()'); row=cursor.fetchone(); assert row[1]=='capacity_ci'; assert redis.Redis(host='redis').ping(); f=tempfile.TemporaryFile(dir='/tmp'); f.write(b'synthetic-media'); f.seek(0); assert f.read()==b'synthetic-media'; f.close(); print(json.dumps({'postgres':row[0],'database':row[1],'redis_ping':True,'migrations_applied':True,'temporary_media_io':True,'django':django.get_version()}))

CAPACITY_DELIVERY_COMPLETE = True

")
